title: Cleaning Service Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control site preparation, cleaning, disinfection, inspection, and secure handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete cleaning service customer completion sign-off for rooms, surfaces, fixtures, chemicals, tools, and controlled items. It connects cleaning plan, product label, safety data, and site instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained cleaning technician or team lead and customer or authorized facility representative must reconcile the promised cleaning service scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.guidance: Present the actual observations and limitations supporting the completion claim.

sections.title: Cleaning Service limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Chemical label, SDS, dilution, compatibility, or container identity uncertain
Uncontrolled mixture, reaction, spill, vapor, or exposure concern
Sharps, blood, bodily fluid, mold, pest, or unknown material outside scope
Wet floor, blocked egress, trip, electrical, or moving-equipment hazard
Ventilation, PPE, eyewash, first-aid, or spill-response resource unavailable
Occupied or restricted area cannot be isolated as required
Food, medication, record, valuable, electronic, or personal item may be affected
Surface or finish may be damaged by the proposed product or method
Security key, badge, alarm, door, or privacy-control discrepancy
Customer requests disinfection, remediation, or waste handling beyond authorization

blocks.guidance: Use this cleaning service customer completion sign-off with the applicable customer agreement, manufacturer information, product instructions, site policy, licensing, safety, privacy, and retention requirements. It records the stated decision but does not create authority, coverage, compliance, or release when identity, evidence, scope, condition, or acceptance remains unresolved.
